note: Story podcasts picked by hand: the feed is read, the sound of its newest episode answers, it is being updated (checked with devtools/check_shows.py). `platform` is where the show lives (ximalaya, xiaoyuzhou, lizhi, wavpub, heymeow); `style` is one of the ids in `styles`. The lists of /api/listen add the shows of Apple's China charts whose name says a story (stories.py), so this list is the floor, not the whole.

shows.name: 鲶鱼夜话
shows.why: 听友投稿的民间灵异和怪谈，每期几个故事。
shows.why_en: Folk ghost stories sent in by listeners, a few in each episode.

shows.name: 哈喽怪谈
